reviews.text:
I cannot, in good conscience, recommend this establishment.
I brought my dog here for a grooming appointment, and within hours I had to take her to the emergency room where she later passed. Prior to the appointment, she had been in good health with no known issues. The sudden change in her condition shortly after the groom was very shocking.
Documentation of the ER visit was shared with Tammy. During that conversation, additional details about the appointment were mentioned that had not been shared when we initially asked what had occurred.
We also requested video footage from the grooming session in an effort to better understand what may have happened. But were told only still images were available, and despite requesting them, they have not been provided.
Since this incident, we have spoken with former employees, experienced groomers, and others in the industry who raised serious concerns about practices at this facility, including the use of force, prolonged kennel times, and overcrowding due to overbooking amongst other concerning practices.
What has been most difficult in this situation is the lack of transparency, communication, and compassion following such a serious incident.
Our dog was a deeply loved member of our family, and losing her so suddenly without clear answers has been heartbreaking. I hope by sharing our experience, other pet owners will  think twice about this establishment.

Even her previous employer said that she puts shock collars on dogs and is ver careless, our dog was only 6 pounds and died after picking her up from this establishment. Do not use this place! Go somewhere else that actually cares about your pets
Tammi is best in the business! The only groomer we trust with our pup
Always happy with Henry’s grooming - and he’s always happy with Tammy :)

So, friendly & kind. And, thorough. On our way out she noticed that my boys paws had been overlooked (I hadn’t noticed), and she stopped us so that she could trim them before we left. Much appreciated!!!
PawTenders does a great job grooming my Australian Shepard and let's him get his play on while he's there. He comes home happy and beautiful!

They take great care of my prized possession and she loves being there! Always excited when they come to pick her up!!! Plus there’s always someone there looking after the pups so they’re never left alone! That’s huge for me!!
